description: The AUTO-GATED backlog from one place, newest first: unreviewed article-level transposition links with BOTH provision texts side by side and the stored reasoning, model/low-confidence concept tags, draft topic descriptions and jurisdiction notes, and recorded findings (gaps and divergences a round could not decide). Filter by kind, vertical and jurisdiction. EVERYTHING HERE IS UNREVIEWED EVIDENCE — cite none of it as a finding. This tool is READ-ONLY: verdicts are set only by a human with a 'reviewer' key, and no MCP tool can set one.

chars.description: Characters of provision text per side. Omit for the WHOLE text, which is the default: a character budget once hid two parts of a French code article and produced two false absences.

kind.description: Comma-separated kinds: transposition, tag, topic-description, jurisdiction-note, finding. Omit for all.

lowConfidence.description: Also list non-model classifier tags at or below this confidence. Omit for model tags only — the keyword baseline's weak tail is 24 000 rows and would bury the 157 links a verdict changes.

offset.description: Skip this many items — the queue is paged, not sampled.

name: list_review_queue

outputSchema.description: The JSON response from the corresponding Lexiara API route.

title: What is waiting for a human verdict
